title: NewsNation finds nothing in the Vatican files

tellings.quote: NewsNation itself went to the Vatican and checked in the Vatican files. Said we couldn't find anything.

plain: A well-known skeptic and writer, Michael Shermer, brings up a claim tied to the Vatican, the headquarters of the Catholic Church, and to the year 1933. He says that NewsNation, an American TV news channel, went to the Vatican and searched its files itself, and reported that it could not find anything. He tells it because if the claim were true, the Church's own records would be expected to show it.
